State estimation & sensor fusion: 状态估计与传感器融合
Reconstruct coupled-tank levels from inc: 使用因果非线性扩展卡尔曼滤波器，从不完整、异步观测中重建耦合水箱液位。
Reconstruct coupled-tank levels from incomplete, asynchronous observations with a causal nonlinear EKF.
O = [H; HA] uses the continuous hydrauli: O = [H; HA] 使用所选工作点的连续水力学雅可比矩阵。矩阵秩仅描述局部性质，不能证明全局非线性可观测性。奇异值混合了 SI 单位下的测量与导数尺度；条件数仅用于诊断，并非信息界限。

O = [H; HA] uses the continuous hydraulic Jacobian at the selected point. Rank is local and does not establish global nonlinear observability. Singular values mix measurement and derivative scales in SI units; conditioning is a diagnostic, not an information bound.
One sensor can reconstruct both states w: 在光滑工作点且水力耦合非零时，一个传感器可以重建两个状态。连接阀完全关闭时，未测水箱不可观测。等液位及干涸出口处不存在经典平方根雅可比矩阵。

One sensor can reconstruct both states when hydraulic coupling is nonzero at a smooth point. With a fully closed connection valve, the unmeasured tank is unobservable. Equal levels and dry outlets have no classical square-root Jacobian.

Green: EKF · blue: observations · amber:: 绿色：EKF · 蓝色：观测 · 琥珀色：开环 · 灰色：先验预测 · 紫色：条件 95% 区间。缺失数据保留为空。
Green: EKF · blue: observations · amber: open-loop · gray: prior prediction · purple: conditional 95% interval. Gaps remain missing.
Intervals condition on the assumed model: 区间以假定模型、Q 和 R 为条件。偏置、未建模故障、边界投影和非线性可能使高斯校准失效。NIS 维度为当前测量数（1 或 2）；NEES 维度为 2 个状态。卡方期望要求模型正确、扰动无偏且相互独立并服从高斯分布。时间样本存在相关性；这些是诊断量，并非独立置信检验。

Intervals condition on the assumed model, Q and R. Bias, unmodeled faults, boundary projection and nonlinearities can invalidate Gaussian calibration. NIS has the current measurement dimension (1 or 2); NEES has 2 states. Chi-square expectations assume a correct model and unbiased independent Gaussian disturbances. Time samples are correlated; these are diagnostics, not independent confidence tests.
Near a dry or equal-level boundary, the: 接近干涸或等液位边界时，滤波器使用有限分辨率割线。局部高斯不确定性可能不可靠。
Near a dry or equal-level boundary, the filter uses a finite-resolution secant. Local Gaussian uncertainty may be unreliable.
